title: Which of six shortlisted sites a regional grocer should open in 2027, and what it adds to the chain's annual contribution, with the distribution centre's cases a week and the paid hours a week by store and the bus departures near each site
subdomain: accessibility-agglomeration-location-analysis (a new grocery store's trade from a spatial-interaction model of every origin's grocery spend within reach, sized as its addition to the chain's contribution)
prompt_shape: other: one of six sites with its sized addition, and three per-store or per-site measures from the chain's operational records (ten, ten and six figures)
stated_inputs: the spend-share model's parameters and Finance's appraisal rule (spend_share_model_2025.pdf)
the six sites' floor areas and running costs (site_shortlist_2027.xlsx)

sources.origin: generated by task305/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional regional grocer with ten stores in a fictional planning region of twelve towns and their rural parishes (postcode area LQ, placed on the British National Grid): output areas with households and spend, the rating list, the chain's stores and the competitors, holiday parks whose guests live outside the region, an acquirer's card feed by home sector, the distribution centre's trips, the stores' shifts and clocking punches and two bus operators' timetables; layouts follow the public files named, every organisation, place and person is invented, and no real dataset is reproduced.
